rationale: Mechanical repairs only — no new prose. (1) Quoted history rebuilt from the real In-Reply-To parent with thread_kit.quote_block in the sender's client style, replacing 'From: EMAIL-NNN / Subject: (prior subject)' and 'On <date>, EMAIL-NNN wrote:' placeholders and their wrong dates at every nesting level. (2) Signature blocks that carry another org (e.g. L&L lawyers with the Cascade block) or a variant block replaced with the sender's canonical corpus signature. (3) Subject parcel ID aligned to the parcel the body and attachment name (subject was the templated field; body/attachment carry the substance). In-Reply-To links themselves are headers and stay as-is, even where incoherent (see audit info flags).
